messages:
Ava (Sales): ProspectCorp wants a 3-week technical POC. Key asks: BYO-CMK with HSM attest, ability to trigger quarterly rotations, and decrypt audit trail per request. They expect 400 rps and median token latency <65ms. Can we run this in us-east-1?
Noah (Solutions Eng): Yes, us-east-1 supported. Quick clarifying Qs: do they want per-token KMS unwraps or are ephemeral wrapping allowed? Ephemeral wrapping will massively cut KMS calls.
Priya (ProspectCorp): Ephemeral wrapping is fine for POC, but final contract may require stricter custody. For POC we need: 1) attestation doc, 2) a demo rotation where we trigger and you show no downtime.
Lina (CryptoOps): We can provide HSM attestation and a rotation dry-run. For the dry-run we use staged dual-wrap and phased traffic shift. We'll need to run it in staging first.
Kai (SRE): Performance note: ensure KV prefix cache + ephemeral-wrap enabled to hit median <65ms at 400 rps. I'll prepare a staging config and run a synthetic load. Also need ProspectCorp to whitelist staging IPs.
Ava (Sales): Pricing question: will KMS API usage be included in POC or billed separately? ProspectCorp prefers predictable caps.
Noah (Solutions Eng): For POC we include a capped KMS budget. Post-POC we bill passthrough for KMS calls for BYO-CMK or a small managed-key premium for our CMK. I'll add numbers to the SOW.
Priya (ProspectCorp): Sounds good. Also security questionnaire Q7 asks: Do you perform key ceremonies and are customers allowed to observe?
Lina (CryptoOps): Short answer to Q7: "Yes. Redwood uses FIPS-validated HSMs; key ceremonies are documented and customers may observe. Attestation reports are provided on request for POC and enterprise deployments." Use that in the questionnaire.
Kai (SRE): Action items: 1) I'll run stress test with config flags (--prefetch-kv, --ephemeral-wrap) and post p50/p95 (ETA 48h). 2) Lina to produce attestation paragraph + rotation runbook (ETA 36h). 3) Sales to capture KMS budget line in SOW (EOD). 4) ProspectCorp to send whitelist (today).
Priya (ProspectCorp): Whitelist sent. NDA addendum attached in email.
deploy-bot: created staging cluster prospectcorp-poc-use1, pods 10/10 ready
Kai (SRE): Smoke run: p50=39ms p95=85ms with ephemeral-wrap disabled. With ephemeral-wrap + prefetch expected p95 ~65ms. Starting 400 rps run now.
Kai (SRE): Load run results: sustained 400 rps for 10m, p50=41ms p95=69ms with ephemeral-wrap enabled. No errors.
Lina (CryptoOps): Rotation dry-run plan: create new key version, enable dual-wrap for 10m, shift 20% traffic, validate signature acceptance and audit logs, then finalize. Will document and provide checklist.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a short how-to for ProspectCorp on triggering rotation and viewing decrypt logs.
Ava (Sales): Great. Once Lina posts attestation and runbook and I get the KMS budget line, we can confirm kickoff date. Thanks team.
Priya (ProspectCorp): thanks everyone, excited to start.
